name: Tide Archivist
detail: Petrol-blue waxed canvas, oxidized copper, warm coral compass details. Head a squat nautical surveyor helmet whose top is an asymmetric nautilus-shaped copper instrument housing with small off-center compass lens. Body petrol canvas shoulders with rolled chart collars, copper clasps and coral diagonal harness. Pickaxe a copper sextant-shaped crescent blade with calibrated ivory inset and petrol wrapped handle. Glider a broad chart-fold canopy in petrol canvas with copper contour bands and one coral compass pointer emblem; shallow native shape, no hanging ropes.

name: Glass Orchard
detail: Smoked plum metal ribs and jewel-like stained glass sections of peach, pale yellow and leaf green, restrained opaque cel shading, no glow. Head overhead bud-shaped segmented glass helmet with a small asymmetrical folded-metal leaf crest, no face portrait. Body rounded glass-panel shoulders with plum metal veins and a peach apron-like central plate. Pickaxe a long pruning-hook blade shaped from stained-glass leaf segments with dark plum ribs, green wrapped handle. Glider shallow leaf-fan canopy with stained-glass wedge panels, plum frame and side handles. Sophisticated botanical glasswork rather than generic armor.

name: Rivet Sonata

Head top-view sculptural brass soundbox helmet with spiral tuning key, concentric speaker slots, burgundy leather rim; no facial features. Body rounded brass shoulder resonance chambers joined by burgundy accordion bellows and ivory keylike belt accents, no legs. Pickaxe oversized tuning-fork/crescent-tool hybrid with brass head and ivory-black striped grip. Glider a shallow curved accordion-fan canopy with burgundy pleats, brass end caps and dark lateral handles. No musical note icon or floating objects.

name: Polar Frequency
detail: Analog polar-radio survey gear in frost periwinkle, arctic cream and vivid vermilion signal stripes with graphite hardwear. Head overhead rounded radio-radome cap with offset rectangular oscilloscope-like mint panel and short folded aerial fin, not a robot face. Body quilted cream/periwinkle circular shoulders with little ribbed radio housings and vermilion harness. Pickaxe a sharply bent signal-fork ice probe, periwinkle metal head with two asymmetrical graphite tines, cream wrapped shaft and red collar. Glider broad shallow segmented radome-panel canopy, periwinkle and cream with vermilion stripe and dark side handles, no huge antenna or animation.

name: Morrow Loom
detail: Architectural woven textile explorer. Deep indigo, burnt saffron, dusty rose, cream stitchwork. Head overhead sculptural coiled woven-fiber helmet with offset square crown, interlaced indigo/saffron bands, dusty rose folded edge, not a straw hat. Body rounded padded shoulders made of chunky interwoven textile panels with cream stitched seams and saffron central clasp. Pickaxe a carved wooden shuttle-shaped crescent tool with indigo lacquered curved blade and tightly woven rose/cream handle. Glider shallow tensioned woven-kite canopy with bold indigo/rose/saffron interlaced geometry and dark wood side handles. Fabric texture through large graphic stitches only, avoid fine noisy print.
